exposure: Typical chest imaging findings of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD)
outcome: Mortality between 28 days after birth and 2 years of age
cohort: 256 preterm infants with BPD who were admitted between 2014 and 2018
finding: Those with typical imaging findings had a remarkably higher mortality rate, higher proportion of severe BPD, and higher rate of HOT at discharge than those without typical imaging findings.
